method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A speckled plane with two outlines, the hull a speck, no place or scale
notes.fix: Drop to a 300 m oblique with the channel and bank in the lower fifth and the hull at true scale in the near third

notes.problem: A noise-textured plane with a blue outline, the hull a few pixels, an aliased foot band
notes.fix: Drop the camera to about 250 m oblique over the channel edge with riprap and reflective water in the near third and the hull at least 120 px long

notes.problem: A noise plane with outline strips under fog, the hull a 4 px speck
notes.fix: Pull back and south so the channel and bank fill the lower third with the hull at least 40 px long

notes.problem: Mannequin residents with a torn hair mesh, a man not on his chair, a blank seal, flat light
notes.fix: Seat every resident on a chair, swap the broken mesh, and let the window throw a raking key across the dais

notes.problem: Avatar mesh tears, an empty dais, no window
notes.fix: Put a lit window behind the dais with three commissioners seated, and push the near heads out of frame

notes.problem: Collar mesh tears, an empty dais, a blank seal
notes.fix: Swap the nearest figures, seat five commissioners backlit by the window, map the county seal

notes.problem: The same noise ground, white box warehouses, a quay with no built edge
notes.fix: Model the quay as a bulkhead with bollards and a cast shadow and lower the camera to about 120 m

notes.problem: Untextured box buildings, a near-black channel, the hull a speck
notes.fix: Give the channel frame 1's water and moor the hull at the near build position at about 15 percent of the width

notes.problem: Flat strips and identical boxes reading as a game board, a black channel
notes.fix: Drop to about 80 m along the bank with the hull moored at the quay and varied building heights

notes.problem: The hull sits against the far-bank riprap and the range leader lands on the radome
notes.fix: Push the far bank back and land the range leader midship

notes.problem: A flat barge slab with no reflection, the range label past the safe margin
notes.fix: Model sheer and flare, add a dark planar reflection, and end the label at x 1000 css

notes.problem: The radome under the label, arbitrary leader anchors, the hull jammed against the far bank
notes.fix: Move the range label above the mast, land the leaders on the bow wash and midship, lower the camera

notes.problem: The dek crosses the deckhouse and the hull's underside is a black mass
notes.fix: Pull the camera right and back and add a ground-bounce fill under the hull

notes.problem: The dek sits on the lit deckhouse and the block line can't be read
notes.fix: Pan right and pull back so the sheer sits below the dek with daylight under the keel

notes.problem: The deckhouse behind the dek, the block line a dark wall, a glassy deckhouse
notes.fix: Move the hull down and left, use frame 1's matte plate, and space the blocks

notes.problem: The deckhouse fills the frame and reads as a lighthouse
notes.fix: Model chamfered plate with sensor arms and a lattice mast, and drop the camera to the waterline so the bow leads the frame

notes.problem: Frame 5 with the hull deleted leaves a dead middle third
notes.fix: Leave the empty keel blocks standing along the line with their contact shadows

notes.problem: No reflection or shadow under the hull, flat noon light, a blurred foreground strip
notes.fix: Add the hull's reflection and wash, lower the sun to about 35 degrees, bring riprap into the lower-left corner

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
